doc.title: Product Changeover and Line Clearance, Lines 1 and 3
doc.file: SOP-105 Product Changeover and Line Clearance Lines 1 and 3.pdf
doc.purpose: Change between products of the same bottle size without mixing product, labels or caps.

roles.name: Operator
roles.does: Clears the line and loads the new materials.

roles.name: Batching Operator
roles.does: Flushes the supply line from the mixing tank.

references.as_written: WI-210 Filler Setup and Nozzle Check
WI-212 Labeler Setup and Label Roll Change

parameters.applies_to: MIX-1 or MIX-2 to the filler
parameters.quote: Flush the supply line from MIX-1 or MIX-2 to the filler with water for 10 minutes.

rules.statement: The Shift Lead walks the line with FRM-PR-05 and signs only when nothing from the old product remains.
rules.quote: Sign only when nothing from the old product remains.

rules.statement: The Batching Operator flushes the supply line from MIX-1 or MIX-2.
rules.quote: Batching Operator: Flush the supply line from MIX-1 or MIX-2 to the filler

rules.statement: The QA Technician gives first-off approval, including a label and lot code check.
rules.quote: First-off approval as described in QP-306, including a label and lot code check.

unsure.what: Scope says the clearance steps also apply to Line 2 size changeovers
unsure.why: Not stated whether the Batching Operator flush applies to a Line 2 size change (SOP-104 does not mention it)

unsure.what: Products AC-1000, AC-1000-LEM, DS-0750, DS-0750-ECO named in scope
unsure.why: No field for products in the schema
